full_page.content:
1945, December 5
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 JEROME STREET BROOKLYN 7, N.Y. December 5# 1945
Dear Brother Leo:
God bless you and yours!
Many thanks for favors last week. Am sending you a few of the badges asked for. We've not been receiving any of late, The sister in Cleve- land so active in that line for some years wrote in October that she ... could not continue. Miss Modock also hopes to go to the convent ... can probably not continue. O well as long as we have them we can share. After all it was the dear Lord sent them so far and if it please Him we hope the beautiful sup- ply may continue.
Dear Brother Leo, our equipment here for Ser Mass Association is rather behind time. Will you see if Fr. Lambert could muster an extra loose- leaf outfit - as you and Bro. Rufin or someone else introduced a year or so ago. We would ap- preciate it for the new year. In the meantime we'll drill along and do what we can under handi- cap of old "machinery" etc. - always ocourse praying for one anothers final conversion. Praised be Jesus Christ. Best wishes and happy Feast of the Immaculate Conception.
Fraternally in the Sacred Heart. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap., sinner
